revenue_visibility.label: Repeat revenue
revenue_visibility.definition: How much of the sales are likely to recur. Read from the accounts for the leading companies; estimated from the type of business for the rest.

strategy_fit.label: Fits the case
strategy_fit.definition: How closely the business matches the investment case. Only companies confirmed to trade in the sector are ranked.

size_fit.label: Right size
size_fit.definition: EBITDA (profit before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation) in the £2–15m range most mid-market buyers target.

margin_quality.label: Profit margin
margin_quality.definition: How high the EBITDA margin is and, where three or more years of accounts have been read, how steady it has been.

balance_sheet.label: Balance sheet
balance_sheet.definition: Net assets, cash and margin headroom, reduced where interest cover is thin or net debt is above 1x EBITDA. A first check, not a full measure of how much a buyer could borrow.

confidence: High, Medium or Low: how far the figures can be trusted. Shown beside the score, never added to it.

Steady compounder.label: Steady compounder
Steady compounder.definition: Recurring-type revenue, margin of 10% or more, sales not falling and a steady margin.

High-growth.label: High-growth
High-growth.definition: Sales growing 20% a year or more over several years (25% if only one year is known).

Fixable dip.label: Fixable dip
Fixable dip.definition: Falling sales or a thin margin, with a named problem and a fix.

Under pressure.label: Under pressure
Under pressure.definition: Falling sales or a thin margin, and no fix identified yet.
Under pressure.suits: None until a fix is identified

Growth infrastructure.label: Growth infrastructure
Growth infrastructure.definition: Loss-making while building a network, but growing. Not ranked; on the watchlist.

Between buckets.label: Between types
Between buckets.definition: Good on some tests, not others, for the reason given.

Numbers to check.label: Numbers to check
Numbers to check.definition: Something in the figures needs checking before the company can be typed.

readiness_checks.buyable: Owner able and likely to sell
readiness_checks.price: A buyer could make 20% a year inside the price range
